segments.contextAfter: `handler`: The block to execute when the user taps the button associated with this action. UIKit makes a copy of the block you provide. When the user selects the action represented by this object, UIKit executes your `handler` block on the app’s main thread. This parameter must not be `nil`. This block has no return value and takes the following parameters: - **action**: The action object representing the action that the user selected.
